That widens the spread SD to ~7.5pp with fat tails, since a succession announcement could hit in the window. Centre near zero: a post-selloff bounce and continued rotation into AAPL roughly cancel. No human market matches (Kalshi has a Huang-return market; the Manifold Big Tech vs BTC market is unrelated).

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the window (P0 = Nov 20 close, P1 = Dec 4 close, 9 trading days, earnings excluded), on the facts of the crisis, on a median near 0, and that no market matches. They differ in three places. (1) Normal-regime spread SD: 5-6 vs 6-7pp. Nobody opened the spreadsheet, so this cannot be settled here; it matters little because the current regime dominates.
